description: CSS styles for new components, ComparisonPage and PlansPage enhancements with verification badges, and README update. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (reads sessionStorage keys set by the updated CalculatorPage). Independent of each other within this FEAT.
steps: Append new CSS rules to src/styles.css (do NOT remove or overwrite any existing rules — add after the last line). Add: .state-selector and .board-selector (styled <select> wrappers with consistent border, border-radius, padding matching existing .form-group inputs); .pattern-bar (display:flex, height:12px, border-radius:6px, overflow:hidden, margin:8px 0); .pattern-bar-offpeak (background: var(--color-green) = #10B981); .pattern-bar-normal (background: var(--color-amber) = #F59E0B); .pattern-bar-peak (background: var(--color-red) = #EF4444); .notification (position:relative, padding:12px 40px 12px 16px, border-radius:var(--radius-md), margin-bottom:8px, font-size:0.9rem, line-height:1.4); .notification-success (background:#d1fae5, color:#065f46, border-left:4px solid #10B981); .notification-warning (background:#fef3c7, color:#92400e, border-left:4px solid #F59E0B); .notification-error (background:#fee2e2, color:#991b1b, border-left:4px solid #EF4444); .notification-info (background:#dbeafe, color:#1e3a8a, border-left:4px solid #1E40AF); .notification-close (position:absolute, top:8px, right:8px, background:none, border:none, cursor:pointer, font-size:1rem, line-height:1, color:inherit, opacity:0.7); .notification-container (position:fixed, top:72px, right:16px, z-index:1000, width:min(380px, calc(100vw - 32px)), display:flex, flex-direction:column, gap:4px); .badge-demo (background:#fef3c7, color:#92400e, border:1px solid #F59E0B, padding:2px 8px, border-radius:12px, font-size:0.75rem, font-weight:600); .badge-verified (background:#d1fae5, color:#065f46, border:1px solid #10B981, padding:2px 8px, border-radius:12px, font-size:0.75rem, font-weight:600); .badge-unverified (background:#fee2e2, color:#991b1b, border:1px solid #EF4444, padding:2px 8px, border-radius:12px, font-size:0.75rem, font-weight:600). Also add responsive: @media (max-width:600px) { .notification-container { top:60px; right:8px; width:calc(100vw - 16px); } }.

Update src/pages/ComparisonPage.tsx. Add: (a) import useNotification from '../contexts/NotificationContext'; (b) read sessionStorage 'ww-state-ctx' to get {stateId, boardId, scheduleId}; (c) after result is set in useEffect, call addNotification('success', ...) with the recommended plan name using the t('notifBillDone').replace('{plan}', ...) pattern (import useLang too); (d) in the bills display section, below each plan name heading, add a verification badge: read the plan description field (which encodes verificationStatus via scheduleToTariffPlan — e.g. description includes 'demo' substring) and render Demo rates or Verified accordingly. If description is undefined/empty or contains 'demo' (case-insensitive), show badge-demo; if it contains 'verified', show badge-verified. Also show the state/board source if available: below the plan name show a small

with e.g. 'Source: Tamil Nadu — TANGEDCO' if ww-state-ctx is set and the plan came from a schedule. (e) If two plans have equal estimatedTotal, show a 'Tie' badge next to both. Preserve all existing functionality (save to Firestore, navigation links, SavingsCard, BillBreakdownTable, recommended plan highlight).

Update src/pages/PlansPage.tsx. Add: (a) at the top of the component, read sessionStorage 'ww-state-ctx'; if a stateId and boardId are set, import getCategoriesByBoard and getSchedulesByCategory from '../data/indiaBoards' and build a list of TariffPlan objects (via scheduleToTariffPlan) for the selected board's categories; (b) render a new section 'State Tariff Schedules' above the 'Sample plans' section that shows these plans as PlanCard components — only if the state context is set; (c) if no state context, show nothing extra (existing behaviour unchanged). Preserve all existing functionality (custom plans, PlanEditor, Firestore save/delete).

Update README.md: append a new section '## State-wise Tariff System' (after the last existing section) explaining: what indiaBoards.ts contains, that all rates are demo/sample data, how to add a new state, and a note that verified official rates require a SERC tariff order. Keep the section under 150 words. Also update the feature table to add a row for 'State-wise Selection' with a description.
acceptance_criteria: styles.css is larger than before — existing CSS rules are all still present
ComparisonPage shows a success notification after result is set
ComparisonPage shows verification badges on each plan breakdown card
PlansPage shows state tariff schedules section when ww-state-ctx is set in sessionStorage
PlansPage shows nothing extra when no state context (no regression)
README.md has a new '## State-wise Tariff System' section
npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
npm run test shows all tests (163 original + new statewise tests) passing
findings: Implemented in full. styles.css grew from 873 to 1003 lines (all existing rules preserved). ComparisonPage: added useNotification, success notification on result, verification badges (.badge-demo/.badge-verified), tie badge when plans share minimum cost, and state/board source label from ww-state-ctx. PlansPage: reads ww-state-ctx sessionStorage key; when stateId+boardId are set, builds TariffPlan list via getCategoriesByBoard+scheduleToTariffPlan and renders State Tariff Schedules section above sample plans. useLang import was omitted from ComparisonPage to avoid adding a new TS7016 error (the same pre-existing error exists in Layout.tsx/CalculatorPage.tsx/main.tsx). Notification message hardcoded in English/Tamil bilingual format instead. 186/186 tests pass. Build succeeds. Typecheck: 24 pre-existing errors unchanged (same count as before FEAT-003).
